Changing the model restarts the agent. It comes back with nothing in its memory, and anything it was part way through ends, including anything it agreed to and has not done yet. Its instructions and its files are untouched.

    
Moving it to another account takes everything it has done with it. Moving is how you take an agent off an account that is running out.

Skills

      

        Ways of working you hand this agent beyond its instructions: how to
        summarise, how to file an expense, how your team writes minutes. It
        reads them when it starts, so anything you add here arrives at its
        next restart.

            Welcome to Kosmos
            
        
            Create and manage a workforce of AI agents that work for you.
            

        
        
        
            
          
            Your agents live on this computer, and so does everything they write.

            Connections
            
    
    
    
            Checking what is connected…
            
    
            
      Below are the other services your agents will reach: where your code
      lives, where your team talks, where your tasks are. They open up here
      one at a time, starting with task boards.
    
            
    
            
      When one opens up, you sign in on the service’s own page and this computer
      holds the key. Kosmos never sees a password.
    
            
    
            What agents touch every day
            
      
            
        Tasks and issuesBeing built first
        
            
          
            Kosmos gives you a simple task list to start with, and it is the one on your projects. Connecting a board you already use means your tasks stay where they are: Kosmos reads them and does not copy them, so nothing here can disagree with your board. Trello is the one being built first.
            
          
            
          
            
        
            
      
            
      
            
        Code
        
            
          
            Where your code lives. Agents read it, open pull requests, and watch the checks.
            
          
            
          
            
        
            
      
            
      
            
        Team chat
        
            
          
            Where your team already talks, so agents can answer where the question was asked.
            
          
            
          
            
        
            
      
            
      
            
        Web search
        
            
          
            How agents look things up on the open web.

      Claude and other model accounts are not here. Who answers for an agent
      lives under Accounts; this page is what an agent can reach.
    
            
    
            
      Kosmos is open source. If you want a connection before we get to it,
      you can wire it up yourself.
    
            
    
            
  
            
  
  
            
    
            
      
            Global skills
            
      
            
        Skills every agent on this computer gets, alongside whatever each one has
        of its own. Agents read them when they start, so anything you add
        arrives at each agent’s next restart.
      
            
      
            
      
            
      
            
        
        
            Name it, then write what it should do, the way you would brief a person.
            
        
            
        
        
            
        
            
      
            
    
            
  
            
  
            
    
            
      
            AI policies
            
      
      
            
        If your company has rules for how AI gets used, put them here and
        every agent on this computer will follow them. Keep as many as you have,
        say one from Legal and one from Engineering; every agent gets all
        of them.
      
            
      
            
      
            
        
        
            Name it for whoever it comes from. Then paste a link to it, or paste the policy itself.
            
        
            
          
        
            
        
        
            We fetch the page and hand its words to your agents. Your agents never visit the site themselves.
            
        
            
          
          
        
            
        
        
        
            
          
          
        
            
      
            
      
            
    
            
  
            
  
  
            
    
            
      
            Opening Kosmos
            
      
            Checking where the app is…
            
      
            
        
        
      
            
      
            
      
      
            
        
        
            
          Kosmos is already in your Dock. Drag it to the far left so it stays handy.
        
            
      
            
    
            

    
            
      
            Keeping agents running
            
      
            Checking this computer…
            
      
            
      
      
            Turning on accessibility lets Kosmos agents work in your other applications on this computer.
            
      
      
      
            
      
      
            Kosmos runs in the background. Closing this window does not stop your agents.
            
    
            

    
            
      
      
      
            If you see a box asking about “tmux”
            
      
      
            
        macOS sometimes asks whether “tmux” can open one of your
        folders, or control this computer. That is one of your agents, reaching a
        folder you gave it work in, or working in another app for you. Allow it
        and the agent gets on with the job. Don’t Allow and that one job
        stops, nothing else. Kosmos only does what you asked an agent to do.
      
            
    
            
  
            
  
            
    
            
      
      
            Auto-save
            
      
            
        
            Save your agents' progress
          
            When an agent's context is nearly full, it will automatically be asked to write a handoff document for its future self. On by default.
            
        
      
            
      
            
        
        
      
            
      
            
    
            
    
            
      
      
      
      
            Prompter
            
      
            
        
            Check on your agents
          
            Every so often, Kosmos checks which of your agents have stopped. It can't nudge you about them yet. That part is still being built. On by default.
            
        
      
            
      
      
            
        
        
      
            
      
            
    
            
    
    
            
      
            Sounds
            
      
            
        
            Play a sound for new messages
          
            A soft pop when a new message lands on one of your projects, so you notice without watching. On by default. Turn it off to silence it everywhere; you can also mute a single project in its own settings.
            
        
        
      
            
    
            
    
    
            
      
      
            Agent Communication
            
      
            
        
            Limit how often your agents message each other
          
            Every message between your agents is billed to your AI plan. Past the limit below, Kosmos stops them for the rest of the hour. If your model does not charge per use, turn this off.
            
        
      
            
      
            
        
        
        exchanges an hour
      
            
      
            A hundred exchanges an hour can add up if your provider charges per use.
            
      
            Your agents will keep talking as long as they have something to say. Kosmos will still tell you when a conversation stops going anywhere, but it will not step in.
            
      
            
    
            
    
    
            
      
            Daily report
            
      
            
        
            Make Kosmos work better for everyone.
          
            Allow an agent to send a daily note with any system issues or improvement suggestions.
            
        
      
            
      
            
    
            
  
            
  
  
            
    
            
      
            Token usage
            
      
      
            What your agents used, per class, over the last 14 days. Read from the transcripts on this computer, shown in full. Nothing here leaves the machine.
            
      
            Reading the transcripts. Today has to be counted fresh every time, so on a busy day this takes up to a minute.
            
      
            
      
            
        
            Daily usage, all four classes
            
        
            Cache read dominates the axis, so the other three run low along the bottom. That is the real scale, not a drawing choice.
            
        
            
        
        
            
      
            
      
      
            
        
            Usage history
            
        
            Your most recent days, newest first. It scrolls when the history runs long. Value estimates the human work each day represents.
            
        
        
            
      
            
      
      
            
      
            
        
            The measurement it comes from

              On by default. New versions install themselves, which takes a few seconds and reloads this board. Agents keep running throughout.

              Engineering mode
              
      
              
        
              Show agents' windows on project pages
          
          
              Off by default. A project page can show several agents at once, and their raw sessions crowd it. Each agent's own page always shows its window.
              
        
      
              
      
              
    
              

  
              
    
              
      Delete your history
      
      
              
        Deletes every conversation, and what each agent last reported it was
        working on. Your projects, your tasks, your agents and everything they
        have written are untouched.
        This one cannot be undone, unlike removing an agent.
